workflow.name: QuotePilot-MinExtract-20261110-A
workflow.description: Isolated one-shot synthetic RFQ. Derived from built-in template 8; no SQL, external files, schedules or service.
workflow.dsl_yaml:
workflow:
  name: quotepilot-min-extract-20261110
  root: root
root:
  chain:
  - work_item:
      name: extract_fields
      id: moi:extract
      input:
        documents:
        - id: qp-synthetic-rfq
          content: Please quote 3 EA of PN-0001, condition FN, synthetic valve spec
            A.
        json_schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            part_number:
              type: string
              description: Exact part number
            quantity:
              type: integer
            unit:
              type: string
            condition:
              type: string
          required:
          - part_number
          - quantity
          - unit
          - condition
        mode: n_to_1
        instruction: Extract only explicit RFQ values. Preserve literal part number,
          unit and condition.
      save:
        extract_result: .result
        extracted_documents: .documents
      version: v1
